title: Sharp — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Sharp.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Simply Smarter." Sharp has been in the microwave business since the 1960s and remains a solid mid-range option. Their over-the-counter (not over-the-range) microwave drawer and standard microwave lines offer reliable performance.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Microwave replacements. Microwave drawer buyers wanting the Sharp drawer concept.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Sharp:

• Microwave drawer concept — unique form factor for kitchen islands

• Decades of microwave manufacturing expertise

• Mid-range pricing with reliable performance

• Over-the-counter models for flexible installation

• Simple, reliable technology
